spire.name: #tower_name#
spire.start_label: The Sorcerer's Spire - a wanderer at the foot of a tower that drinks the light

foot.name: Foot of the Spire
foot.description: The tower rises out of the land like a splinter of night: black glass, seamless and impossibly tall. The air around it is cold and the light seems thinner here, as if something is drinking it.
foot.brief: The foot of the black spire.

exits.description: An arched doorway gapes in the glass.

hall.name: Hall of Echoes
hall.description: Your footsteps come back to you doubled, then tripled, long after you stop moving. Statues stand in alcoves around the walls.

library.name: Library of Ash
library.description: Shelves climb into darkness. Many of the books have been burned where they stand, and ash drifts in the air like grey snow.

stair.name: Winding Stair
stair.description: The stair spirals up through the heart of the tower. Wind moans through gaps in the glass, though there is no wind outside.

description.text: The top of the spire stands open to a clean blue sky. Where the orb hung there is only a scorch mark on the floor, and cracks run singing through the black glass all around you.

The top of the spire is open to a sky that has gone the colour of a bruise. In the centre of the floor a great orb hangs in the air, and light bends toward it from every direction and does not come back.

villain_taunt: "Light is a lie the world tells itself," murmurs {self.name}. "I am only correcting it."
{self.Name} laughs softly. "You came all this way to watch the sun go out?"
"Every candle you ever lit, I have swallowed," says {self.name}. "Yours will be no different."

dead_garden.name: dead garden
dead_garden.appearance: Around the tower's base, a garden has withered to grey stalks.
dead_garden.description: Every plant has died reaching toward the tower, as if it had been pulled.

apprentice_statues.name: statues
apprentice_statues.description: Young men and women in scholars' robes, carved with terrible realism. Every face wears the same look of surprise.

props.text: A plaque beneath each one. They all say the same thing: "Apprentice. Insufficient."

spire_shelves.name: shelves
spire_shelves.contents_text: Among the ruined books, one shelf holds {contents}.
spire_shelves.description: Burned spines, melted scroll-cases, and the smell of something that wasn't paper.

reading_desk.name: reading desk
reading_desk.appearance: A reading desk stands in a circle of unburned floor.
reading_desk.description: Untouched by the fire, as if the flames were afraid of it.

sorcerer_journal.name: black journal
sorcerer_journal.description: Bound in something you hope is leather.

props.text: The handwriting is beautiful and cold. "...the orb grows. When it has eaten enough light, the world will be still at last, and quiet, and mine. Only one thing troubles me: the old relics of true light. I have burned every one I could find. If one survives, it must not be brought to the summit."

dark_orb.name: orb of darkness
dark_orb.appearance: The orb of darkness turns slowly in the air, devouring the light.
dark_orb.description: Looking at it is like looking down a well with no bottom.

touch: Your hand goes numb inches from its surface and you snatch it back.

sorcerer.name: #villain_name#
sorcerer.appearance: {self.Name} stands beside the orb, robed in a darkness that moves when nothing else does.
sorcerer.description: Tall, pale, and very calm. Their eyes are entirely black, like two smaller orbs.

props.death_text: {self.Name} staggers. "No," they whisper, "not like this..." and unravel into smoke.

on_death.say: Without its master the orb shudders, cracks, and bursts like a soap bubble.

choice.prompt: {self.Name} turns, unhurried. "Ah. The hero. Do say something brave."

do: "Because light makes everything visible, and I am tired of seeing." A small, terrible smile. "Soon nobody will have to."

options.text: Stop this and I'll let you live.
do: {self.Name} laughs, genuinely delighted. "Oh, I do like you. I'll keep you for last."
You meet those black eyes in silence. For a heartbeat, something like doubt crosses the sorcerer's face.

profile.motive_text: drink the light out of the world and rule whatever is left in the dark
goals: never be seen by anyone ever again
profile.backstory: "Once I was an apprentice like the ones you passed downstairs. Then I learned what light really costs."

spire_bane.name: shard of star-glass
spire_bane.description: A sliver of crystal that holds a single trapped point of starlight. The one thing in this place the sorcerer failed to burn.

feature.name: ward of shadow

appearance.text: Tatters of a shadow-ward cling to the edges of the way, burned through.
A ward of living shadow churns across the way like smoke that has decided to be a wall.

feature.description: It drinks the light from anything that comes near. Only something brighter could pass.

shadow_ward.open_text: You raise {key}. Its light bites into the ward, which shrieks and shreds into nothing.
shadow_ward.locked_text: The ward pushes you back. You need a true light to burn through it.
shadow_ward.blocked: The ward of shadow pushes you back. You will need a source of true light to pass through it.

title: The Waning Light
Eclipse
The Lightless Crown
spire_eclipse.hook: Each evening the sun sets a little earlier than it should. Candles burn low and blue. Far off, {lair} has risen out of the land, and the old folk say {villain} sits at its top, drinking the light out of the world.
spire_eclipse.goal: Bring a true light - {light} - to {lair} and destroy {heart} before the last light goes out.

resolutions.title: Break the orb
resolutions.text: You raise {means} high. Its light blazes up like a second sun and pours into {target}, which cracks, shrieks, and shatters. Light floods back into the world from every direction.

resolutions.title: Turn the light on its thief
resolutions.text: You turn {means} on {target}. The light takes them like a flood, and when it fades there is only a scorched robe, and {heart} is crumbling to ash.
{target.The} falls, and the darkness they gathered falls apart with them.

lore.title: The waning light
lore.text: Every evening the sun sets a little earlier than it should. The old folk say it began when {villain} raised {lair}.

lore.title: The orb
lore.text: {villain.The}'s journal speaks of {heart}: 'When it has eaten enough light, the world will be still at last, and quiet, and mine. Only the old relics of true light trouble me.'

spire_eclipse.ending: And so the light returned. Songs would be sung about {var.player_name}, most of them wrong and all of them loud. But on quiet evenings, when the sun set exactly when it should, you would sit and watch it go down, and smile.

spire_apprentices.title: The apprentices
spire_apprentices.text: Statues fill the Hall of Echoes: apprentices in scholars' robes, each wearing the same look of surprise. The plaques beneath them all say the same thing: 'Insufficient.'

spire_glass.title: Black glass
spire_glass.text: The spire is made of a single piece of black glass, grown, not built. Light that falls on it does not come back.
